key_insight: The digital quantum simulation framework developed enables efficient simulation of quantum transport dynamics in the nonlinear $ eta$-FPUT lattice.
engineering_relevance: This work provides a foundational algorithmic framework for leveraging fault-tolerant quantum computing in simulating complex quantum phenomena.
method: First-quantized digital quantum-simulation framework targeting fault-tolerant quantum computers.
Trotterized circuit blocks for real-time evolution of lattice structures.
Hermitian quadrature decomposition for mode-resolved displacement correlators.
evidence_signal: The authors provide detailed estimates on qubit counts, gate complexity, and circuit-depth as a function of system size and resolution.
watch_item: Implementation on current quantum hardware may be limited by qubit connectivity and error rates.
paper_title: Digital Quantum Simulation of the quantum $β$-FPUT Lattice: Formulation and Resource Estimation
